definition_en: a thin flat piece cut from something, or to cut it into such pieces

senses.title: A thin flat piece

senses.example: She put a slice of bread on the plate.

senses.why: This is the result of cutting.

senses.title: Cut into pieces

senses.why: This is the action that makes a slice.

senses.title: A share of something

definition_en: the grey gas that rises from a fire, to breathe in tobacco, to give off smoke, or to cure food with smoke

senses.title: Gas from fire
senses.definition: the grey or black gas produced when something burns

senses.whyCN: 烟既能带热，也能保存食物。

definition_zh: 光滑的；顺利的；使平滑；变平静
definition_en: having an even surface, happening without problems, to make even, or to become calm
core_image: 一块被打磨得反光的木板
scene: 婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.
sceneCN: 这里 smooth 是「光滑的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。

senses.title: Even surface
senses.definition: having a surface that is even and not rough
senses.definitionCN: 表面平整而不粗糙
senses.example: The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。
senses.why: This is the physical texture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是描述质感的义项。

senses.title: Without problems
senses.definition: happening without difficulties or sudden changes
senses.definitionCN: 没有困难或突变地发生
senses.example: We had a smooth journey home.
senses.exampleCN: 我们回家的旅程很顺利。
senses.why: An even surface suggests an easy path.
senses.whyCN: 平整的表面暗示顺畅的路径。

senses.title: Make even
senses.definition: to make a surface or situation even or calm

senses.whyCN: 汹涌的水和激动的情绪都会平息。

senses.title: Untrustworthy person

definition_zh: 啪地折断；猛咬；快照；厉声说
definition_en: to break with a sharp sound, to bite suddenly, to take a quick photo, or to speak sharply
core_image: 一根树枝在重压下啪地断成两截
scene: 树枝在重压下啪地断了。The branch snapped under the weight.
sceneCN: 这里 snap 是「啪地折断」（第 1 个义项）；句意：树枝在重压下啪地断了。

senses.title: Break with a sharp sound
senses.definition: to break suddenly with a short sharp sound
senses.definitionCN: 伴随短促尖利的声音突然断裂
senses.example: The branch snapped under the weight.
senses.exampleCN: 树枝在重压下啪地断了。
senses.why: This is the central physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的物理义项。

senses.title: Bite suddenly
senses.definition: to bite something suddenly and quickly
senses.definitionCN: 突然迅速地咬住某物
senses.example: The dog snapped at the fly.
senses.exampleCN: 狗猛地去咬那只苍蝇。
senses.why: A quick bite has the same suddenness.
senses.whyCN: 快速咬合也有同样的突然性。

senses.title: Quick photograph
senses.definition: a quick photograph taken without much preparation
senses.definitionCN: 没有太多准备就快速拍下的照片
senses.example: She snapped a photo of the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 她给那座桥拍了张快照。
senses.why: The shutter makes a small snap.
senses.whyCN: 快门会发出轻轻的咔嚓声。

senses.title: Speak sharply
senses.definition: to speak to someone in a sudden angry way
senses.definitionCN: 突然生气地对某人说话
senses.example: He snapped at me for being late.
senses.exampleCN: 他因为我迟到而厉声斥责我。
senses.why: An angry reply snaps like a dry branch.
senses.whyCN: 愤怒的回应像枯枝一样啪地断裂。

definition_zh: 雪花；雪片；（口语）过度敏感的人；装饰用仿雪花
definition_en: a single crystal of snow, or a small flat piece of something
core_image: 一片六角冰晶落到深色衣袖上，边缘的枝杈还看得清，转眼化成一点水
scene: 孩子伸出手套，一片雪花落在毛线上，转眼就化了。A single snowflake landed on the mitten and melted at once.
sceneCN: 这里该词指「一片雪晶体」（第 1 个义项：单个雪花）；句意为一片雪花落在手套上，立刻融化了。

pos.zh: 雪花；雪片；（口语）过度敏感的人；装饰用仿雪花

collocations.zh: 没有两片雪花完全相同

derivatives.zh: 易碎的；薄片状的；（口语）不可靠的

senses.title: One crystal of snow
senses.definition: a single ice crystal that falls as snow
senses.definitionCN: 作为雪落下的单个冰晶
senses.example: A single snowflake landed on the mitten and melted at once.
senses.exampleCN: 一片雪花落在手套上，立刻融化了。
senses.why: Snow names the mass; the compound singles out one visible piece of that mass.
senses.whyCN: snow 指整片雪体；这个复合词把其中可见的一个个体单独拎出来。

senses.title: The six-armed shape
senses.definition: the six-sided branching form of an ice crystal
senses.definitionCN: 冰晶形成的六角分枝形态
senses.example: Each snowflake showed a six-armed pattern under the lens.
senses.exampleCN: 在放大镜下，每片雪花都显出六角枝杈的图案。
senses.why: The word is also used for the shape itself, because the shape is what makes a flake recognizable.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也指形状本身，因为正是形状让一片雪花可被认出。

senses.title: A flake in flight
senses.definition: a visible piece of snow seen falling through the air
senses.definitionCN: 在空中飘落时可见的一片雪
senses.example: A few snowflakes drifted past the window.
senses.exampleCN: 几片雪花从窗前飘过。
senses.why: In flight, individual pieces are what the eye catches, so the count noun fits the falling moment.
senses.whyCN: 飘落时，眼睛捕捉的是个体，所以可数名词适合这一刻。

senses.title: Falling snow as a mass
senses.definition: snowflakes in the plural, meaning light falling snow
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指轻轻飘落的雪
senses.example: Snowflakes began to fill the dark air.
senses.exampleCN: 雪花开始充满昏暗的空中。
senses.why: Many counted pieces add up to an uncountable mass, so the plural can describe the weather itself.
senses.whyCN: 许多可数的个体相加成不可数的整体，所以复数也能描述天气本身。

senses.title: The uniqueness metaphor
senses.definition: a symbol of something individual and unrepeatable
senses.definitionCN: 象征独特、不可复制之物的意象
senses.example: No two snowflakes are alike, and neither are two students.
senses.exampleCN: 没有两片雪花相同，两个学生也一样。
senses.why: The visible symmetry plus the visible difference made the flake a ready emblem for individuality.
senses.whyCN: 可见的对称加上可见的差异，让雪花成为「个体性」现成的象征。

senses.title: Informal: an over-sensitive person
senses.definition: slang, often derogatory, for someone regarded as too easily offended
senses.definitionCN: 常带贬义的口语，指被认为太容易被冒犯的人
senses.example: The comment was aimed at people the speaker called snowflakes.
senses.exampleCN: 那番话针对的是说话者所谓的「玻璃心」。
senses.why: The metaphor reverses the flake: something lovely and fragile is recast as something that melts under slight heat.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把雪花反过来用：原本可爱脆弱之物，被说成一遇热就化。

senses.title: A decorative imitation
senses.definition: a paper, plastic or glass ornament shaped like a snowflake
senses.definitionCN: 纸、塑料或玻璃制成的雪花形装饰物
senses.example: Paper snowflakes hung from the ceiling in every classroom.
senses.exampleCN: 每间教室的天花板都挂着纸剪的雪花。
senses.why: When the shape is copied, the word follows the shape rather than the frozen material.
senses.whyCN: 当形状被复制时，这个词跟着形状走，而不再跟着冰冷的材质。

senses.title: A classified crystal type
senses.definition: in meteorology, one of the named crystal habits such as a stellar dendrite
senses.definitionCN: 气象学中有专名的晶体形态，如星状枝晶
senses.example: The plate snowflake forms at a different temperature from the needle.
senses.exampleCN: 板状雪花形成的温度与针状雪花不同。
senses.why: Scientific classification needs names for habits, and snowflake serves as the everyday base of those names.
senses.whyCN: 科学分类需要给各类形态命名，snowflake 就成了这些名称的日常词基。

intro.en: Snowflake joins two native words. Snow is ancient and well attested; the origin of flake is disputed and is marked as uncertain.
intro.cn: snowflake 由两个本土词构成。snow 古老且有充分记录；flake 的来源有争议，已标注为存疑。

items.en: Snow comes from Old English snaw, from Proto-Germanic *snaiwaz and PIE *sniegwh-.
items.cn: snow 源自古英语 snaw，出自原始日耳曼语 *snaiwaz 与原始印欧语 *sniegwh-。

items.en: Flake appears in Middle English for a loose piece or a thin layer, especially of snow; its earlier history is marked as source uncertain.
items.cn: flake 在中古英语中表示松散的一片或薄薄一层，尤指雪；其更早历史来源不确定。

items.en: One common suggestion is Old Norse flak 'loose piece, snowflake', but the Norse and English forms do not match cleanly, so this is only a hypothesis.
items.cn: 一种常见推测是古诺斯语 flak「松散的一片、雪花」，但诺斯语与英语形式并不完全吻合，因此只是假说。

items.en: The compound snowflake becomes common in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, helped by the microscope and by printed winter illustrations.
items.cn: 复合词 snowflake 在十八至十九世纪变得常见，显微镜与印刷的冬季插图起了推动作用。

items.en: The meteorology sense is formalized in the twentieth century, and the slang sense for a sensitive person spreads in the twenty-first.
items.cn: 气象义在二十世纪被正式化，指「过度敏感者」的俚语义则在二十一世纪传播开来。

note.en: Group one sets apart words for pieces and masses of snow; group two holds the scientific and everyday neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组区分「雪的个体与整体」相关词；第二组是科学与日常的近邻词。

entries.definition: The fall of snow or its total; it counts events, not individual crystals.
entries.definitionCN: 落雪或其总量；它数事件，不数单个晶体。

entries.definition: A small flat piece of any material, such as paint or cereal; without snow it has nothing to do with weather.
entries.definitionCN: 任何材料的小薄片，如漆片或麦片；不带 snow 时与天气无关。

entries.definition: A long heap of snow at the roadside; it names an accumulation, not a single crystal.
entries.definitionCN: 路边长长的雪堆；它指堆积物，而不是单个晶体。

entries.definition: A solid with a regular internal arrangement of atoms; a snowflake is one kind of ice crystal.
entries.definitionCN: 原子内部规则排列的固体；雪花是冰晶体的一种。

entries.definition: Rain and snow mixed, or partly melted snow; it is a slushy fall rather than a clean crystal.
entries.definitionCN: 雨雪混合或半融的雪；是泥泞的降落，而不是干净的晶体。

entries.definition: A pellet of ice from a thunderstorm; it is rounded and layered, not six-armed like a snowflake.
entries.definitionCN: 雷暴中落下的冰粒；它圆而分层，不像雪花那样六角分枝。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the compound is literal, and the science terms are real.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：复合词是字面组合，所引科学术语也都真实。

normal.en: snow + flake: a flake of snow, just as a flake of paint is a thin piece of paint.
normal.cn: snow + flake：一片雪，正如 a flake of paint 是一片薄漆。

normal.en: snowfall is the mass or the event, and snowflake is the single piece inside it.
normal.cn: snowfall 是整体或事件，snowflake 是其中单个个体。

normal.en: the phrase no two snowflakes are alike is the standard way the uniqueness idea is expressed.
normal.cn: no two snowflakes are alike 是表达「独一无二」这一想法的标准说法。

normal.en: stellar dendrite is the scientific name for the familiar six-armed snowflake shape.
normal.cn: stellar dendrite 是熟悉的那种六角枝状雪花的科学名称。

normal.en: snowflake ornament is the phrase used when the shape is copied in paper or glass.
normal.cn: snowflake ornament 是形状被纸或玻璃复制时使用的说法。

abstract.en: Abstractly, a snowflake is order that appears for a moment and then dissolves: six arms, one instant, then water.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，雪花是短暂出现又消失的秩序：六条枝、一个瞬间，然后变成水。

abstract.en: Its symmetry comes from physics, its difference from history, which is why it can stand for both pattern and individuality.
abstract.cn: 它的对称来自物理，它的差异来自经历，所以它既能代表规律，也能代表个体。

abstract.en: So the word moves easily from weather to metaphor to slang without changing its shape.
abstract.cn: 于是这个词从天气滑向比喻再滑向俚语，而形状始终不变。

examples.en: She caught a snowflake on her tongue and laughed.
examples.cn: 她用舌头接住一片雪花，笑了。

examples.en: The children cut paper snowflakes for the window.
examples.cn: 孩子们剪了纸雪花贴在窗上。

examples.en: Under the microscope the snowflake revealed fine branching.
examples.cn: 在显微镜下，这片雪花显出精细的分枝。

dict_mnemonic.text: snow（雪）+ flake（薄片）：雪的一片薄片 → snowflake 雪花

root: snow 源自古英语 snaw（原始日耳曼语 *snaiwaz，原始印欧语 *sniegwh-）；flake 指松散薄片，更早来源不确定，或与古诺斯语 flak 有关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses grow from one crystal: its shape, its flight, its mass, its use as a sign of uniqueness, its slang life, its paper copy and its scientific type.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一片晶体长出：它的形状、飘落、整体、作为独特性的象征、俚语用法、纸质复制品以及科学类型。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a six-armed piece of ice, visible for a moment, then gone.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片六角冰晶，可见一瞬，随即消失。

branches.en: THE PIECE: one crystal, whether resting on a sleeve or drifting past a window.
branches.cn: 个体：一片晶体，无论停在衣袖上还是飘过窗前。

branches.en: THE SHAPE: the six-armed habit is both a familiar picture and a classified type.
branches.cn: 形状：六角形态既是一幅熟悉的图像，也是一个分类类型。

branches.en: THE MASS: many counted pieces become the weather called falling snow.
branches.cn: 整体：许多可数个体变成名为「飘雪」的天气。

branches.en: THE SYMBOL: uniqueness in praise, fragility in insult.
branches.cn: 象征：赞美时指独一无二，贬损时指脆弱易化。

branches.en: THE COPY: the shape survives in paper and glass after the ice is gone.
branches.cn: 复制：冰消失之后，形状仍留在纸与玻璃上。

intro.en: Snowflake is a snow- compound; the wider family is built by joining snow to nouns for landforms, tools and weather.
intro.cn: snowflake 是 snow 系复合词；更大的词族靠把 snow 与地貌、工具、天气名词拼接而成。

definition_zh: 交往；与人相处；使适应社会规范；使公有化、集体化
definition_en: to meet and spend time with other people in a friendly way, or to train someone to fit into a group
core_image: 一个人先被带去吃午饭，再被拉去周末清扫，点头逐渐变成熟识，最后能与整条街的人自然打招呼
scene: 这里指「交往」。 New employees socialize over lunch and weekend clean-ups until the whole block knows them.
sceneCN: 此处指「在工作之外与人相处、逐渐熟识」（第 1 个义项：以轻松方式与他人交往）；句意为新员工借午餐与周末清扫同大家交往，直到整条街都认识他们。可辨识物件：长餐桌、清扫工具、街区巷道、门牌与笑脸。

pos.zh: 交往；参加社交活动（不及物）
使适应社会规范；使学会群体生活（及物）
使公有化；使集体化（及物）

senses.title: To meet people socially
senses.titleCN: 与人交往、参加社交活动
senses.definition: to spend time with other people in a relaxed, friendly way, especially outside work
senses.definitionCN: 在工作之外以轻松友好的方式与他人共度时光
senses.example: New employees socialize over lunch and weekend clean-ups until the whole block knows them.
senses.exampleCN: 新员工借午餐与周末清扫同大家交往，直到整条街都认识他们。
senses.why: Social plus the verb ending -ize gives 'to make social' or 'to act socially'; the everyday sense is simply to take part in company.
senses.whyCN: social 加动词词尾 -ize 表示「使成为社会的」或「做社会性的事」，日常义就是参与交往。

senses.title: To train someone into a group
senses.definition: to bring a child or newcomer into the expected ways of a group through repeated guidance
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复引导，使儿童或新成员学会群体的期待行事方式
senses.example: The school socializes pupils into queues, bells and shared desks.
senses.exampleCN: 学校把学生训练成习惯排队、听铃声与共用课桌的人。
senses.why: The causative reading 'to make social' turned into 'to make fit for society', which is the base of the sociological noun.
senses.whyCN: 「使成为社会的」这一使动义转为「使适应社会」，这正是社会学名词的基础。

senses.title: To bring under collective ownership
senses.definition: to transfer land, industry or costs from private owners to public or shared control
senses.definitionCN: 把土地、产业或成本从私人所有者转归公共或共同控制
senses.example: The new government moved to socialize the railways within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 新政府上台一年内就着手把铁路公有化。
senses.why: If social means belonging to a community, then to socialize property means to make it belong to the community, a political extension of 'make social'.
senses.whyCN: 如果 social 指属于共同体，那么使财产社会化就是使其归共同体所有，这是「使成为社会的」在政治上的延伸。

senses.title: To introduce a newcomer
senses.definition: to help a new person enter a group by arranging introductions and shared activities
senses.definitionCN: 通过安排介绍与共同活动，帮助新来者进入群体
senses.example: A neighbour socialized the family by inviting them to the block party.
senses.exampleCN: 一位邻居邀请这家人参加街区聚会，使他们融入社区。
senses.why: Mixing is not only pleasure; it is also the act of bringing someone in, so the verb takes on this welcoming sense.
senses.whyCN: 交往不只是消遣，也是把某人带进来的动作，因此这个动词又带上迎接新人的意思。

senses.title: To turn an event into a social occasion
senses.titleCN: 使某项活动成为社交场合
senses.definition: to give an activity a friendly, conversational character rather than a purely practical one
senses.definitionCN: 使某项活动带上友好交谈的性质，而非纯务实性质
senses.example: They socialized the dull committee meeting with coffee and introductions.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用咖啡与自我介绍把沉闷的委员会会议变得像社交聚会。
senses.why: Because the verb means to make something social, it can describe changing the tone of an event, not only attending it.
senses.whyCN: 由于这个动词意为「使某事物具有社会性」，它可以描述改变活动气氛，而不只是出席。

senses.title: To shape behaviour through interaction
senses.definition: to shape a person's habits gradually through repeated contact with others
senses.definitionCN: 通过与他人的反复接触逐步塑造一个人的习惯
senses.example: Playground games socialize children into sharing rules without any formal lesson.
senses.exampleCN: 操场游戏不需要正式课程，就把孩子训练成懂得分享规则的人。
senses.why: This is the psychological side of training: behaviour is shaped by contact, not only by instruction.
senses.whyCN: 这是训练的心理侧面：行为由接触塑造，而不只由教导塑造。

senses.title: To make socially acceptable
senses.definition: to adjust a practice so that it fits accepted social norms
senses.definitionCN: 调整某项做法，使其符合被接受的社会规范
senses.example: The old ceremony was socialized into a public holiday rather than abandoned.
senses.exampleCN: 旧仪式被改造成公共节日而保留下来，并没有被废弃。
senses.why: Things as well as people can be made social, which is why the verb sometimes means bringing a practice into line with public norms.
senses.whyCN: 不只是人能社会化，事物也能，因此这个动词有时指使某项做法符合公共规范。

senses.title: To join group leisure
senses.definition: to take part in the leisure life of a group, such as dinners, games or outings
senses.definitionCN: 参加群体的休闲生活，如聚餐、游戏或郊游
senses.example: On Sundays the whole yard socializes around a long table of fruit and tea.
senses.exampleCN: 每逢星期天，整个院子都围着长桌吃水果喝茶，彼此交往。
senses.why: The narrow everyday reading focuses on leisure rather than training, and it is the sense most common in speech.
senses.whyCN: 这一窄化的日常义聚焦休闲而非训练，是口语中最常见的用法。

intro.en: Socialize is social plus the Greek-derived verb ending -ize. The verb was formed in English and later split into a friendly sense and a technical sense of training or public ownership. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: socialize 由 social 加希腊来源的动词词尾 -ize 构成。这个动词在英语中形成，后来分出「友好交往」与「训练或公有化」两类技术义。年代均为约数。

items.en: Socialis meant 'of companionship or alliance', from socius 'ally'. It reached English as social through Old French.
items.cn: socialis 意为「结伴或联盟的」，源于 socius「盟友」，经古法语进入英语作 social。

items.en: Greek -izein meant 'to make, to act, to cause'. English took it as -ize and used it freely with nouns and adjectives.
items.cn: 希腊 -izein 意为「使、做、造成」，英语借作 -ize，广泛接在名词与形容词后构词。

items.en: Socialize was formed in English on the adjective social, with the literal sense 'to make social'.
items.cn: socialize 是英语在形容词 social 基础上构成的，字面义为「使成为社会的」。

items.en: The literal sense developed into 'to make fit for society', which became the standard term in sociology and education.
items.cn: 字面义发展为「使适应社会」，并成为社会学与教育学的标准术语。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the same verb was applied to property, giving 'to bring into public ownership'.
items.cn: 在十九与二十世纪，同一个动词被用于财产，产生「转为公有」的意思。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English citation of socialize is not precisely dated, and the order in which its senses appeared is reconstructed from later records.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：socialize 的最早英语书证缺乏精确年代，各义项出现的先后顺序是根据较晚记录推定的。

note.en: Group one holds verbs built on the same social root or the same ending; group two holds verbs of joining that differ in tone or in purpose.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 social 词根或同带 -ize 词尾的动词；第二组是语气或目的不同的「加入」类动词。

entries.definition: The adjective for interaction or society; socialize is the verb formed from it.
entries.definitionCN: 表示交往或社会的形容词；socialize 是由它构成的动词。

entries.definition: Names the process that socialize describes in action.
entries.definitionCN: 指 socialize 所述动作的过程名词。

entries.definition: An adjective for a person who easily joins others; it cannot replace the verb in 'socialize with'.
entries.definitionCN: 描述乐于与人相处的形容词，不能替换「与……交往」中的动词。

entries.definition: Means to make widely known; the ending is the same but the base is public, so the meaning is not shared.

entries.definition: To circulate among guests; it stresses movement and casual talk rather than becoming part of a group.
entries.definitionCN: 在宾客间走动交谈；强调走动与闲聊，而非融入群体。

entries.definition: A general verb for combining or associating; socialize adds the friendly, group-life flavour.
entries.definitionCN: 结合或往来的通称；socialize 多一层友好群体生活的意味。

entries.definition: To act on one another, often in a studied or formal way; it need not be friendly leisure.
entries.definitionCN: 彼此施加作用，常用于研究或正式语境，不必是友好休闲。

entries.definition: To keep company with or connect oneself to a group, often with a formal or professional tone.
entries.definitionCN: 与某群体来往或建立联系，常带正式或职业语气。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real related words, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Social plus -ize: the verb literally means to make social or to act in company.
normal.cn: social 加 -ize：动词字面义是「使成为社会的」或在人群中行动。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the sense: socialize with colleagues, socialize children, socialize costs.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出词义：与同事交往、使孩子适应社会、使成本社会化。

normal.en: The family runs socialization, socialized, socializing, social and society.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 socialization、socialized、socializing、social 与 society。

normal.en: The same ending appears in organize, realize and publicize, but each base word sets its own meaning.
normal.cn: 同一词尾也见于 organize、realize 与 publicize，但每个词基决定各自的词义。

normal.en: The technical senses are marked by objects: you socialize children into rules, and you socialize an industry into public hands.
normal.cn: 技术义靠宾语分辨：使孩子学会规则，或使某行业转为公有。

abstract.en: Picture a newcomer standing at the edge of a room until someone pulls out the next chair.
abstract.cn: 想象一个新人站在屋子边缘，直到有人拉出旁边的椅子。

abstract.en: Picture a private gate being opened so that the whole lane may walk through it.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇私人的门被打开，让整条巷子的人都能穿行。

abstract.en: Picture two strangers slowly turning the same dull task into a conversation.
abstract.cn: 想象两个陌生人慢慢把同一件枯燥的事变成一场谈话。

examples.en: The department socializes on Friday afternoons, and nobody talks about work.
examples.cn: 这个部门每周五下午聚会交往，没人谈工作。

examples.en: Board games socialize children into waiting their turn.
examples.cn: 棋盘游戏让孩子学会轮流等待。

examples.en: The council moved to socialize waste collection across the district.
examples.cn: 议会着手把全区的垃圾收集转为公共管理。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「social（社会的）+ ize（使……）」——使彼此变成熟人 → 交往；使适应社会 → 社会化

root: socialize 由 social 加希腊来源词尾 -ize 构成；social 出自拉丁 socialis，词根 socius「盟友」；-ize 出自希腊 -izein「使、做」。该动词在英语中形成，最早书证年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split one verb in two directions: outward into friendly company and inward into training, then into ownership, welcome, tone, shaping, norms and plain leisure.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把这个动词分成两个方向：向外是友好交往，向内是训练，再分出公有化、迎接、气氛、塑造、规范与单纯休闲。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a newcomer at the edge of a room, gradually pulled into its circle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个新人站在屋子边缘，逐渐被拉进圈子。

branches.en: FREE MIXING: the everyday sense is simply friendly company and group leisure.
branches.cn: 自由交往：日常义就是友好结伴与群体休闲。

branches.en: TRAINING: repeated contact and guidance turn a newcomer into a member.
branches.cn: 训练：反复接触与引导把新人变成成员。

branches.en: OWNERSHIP: making something social becomes making it publicly held.
branches.cn: 所有权：使某物具有社会性，转为使其归公共所有。

branches.en: WELCOME AND TONE: one can bring a person in and can also change an event's mood.
branches.cn: 迎接与气氛：既能带人进来，也能改变活动的气氛。

branches.en: NORMATIVE FIT: even a practice can be adjusted to accepted public rules.
branches.cn: 规范适配：连一项做法也能被调整到符合公共规则。

intro.en: The verb joins an English adjective to a Greek verb ending, and its derived words keep the same -iz- spine.
intro.cn: 这个动词把英语形容词接到希腊动词词尾上，其派生词延续同一条 -iz- 词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin socius and socialis supply the base; Greek -izein supplies the ending that makes it a verb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 socius 与 socialis 提供词基；希腊 -izein 提供使其成为动词的词尾。

items.example: The root names the people one joins.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指人所加入的人群。

items.example: The suffix forms social.
The ending forms the verb.

The children were socialized early.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们很早就完成社会化。

items.example: Socializing takes little time here.
items.exampleCN: 这里的交往不占太多时间。

items.example: Socialization is studied in schools.
items.exampleCN: 社会化在学校里被研究。

items.example: Society sets the rules.
She is sociable by nature.

derivatives.meaningCN: 已社会化的；已公有化的

definition_en: a compound used in cooking and cleaning, a sweet fizzy drink, or carbonated water
core_image: 玻璃杯里冒着气泡的冷饮
scene: 他点了一杯加冰的汽水。He ordered a soda with ice.
sceneCN: 这里 soda 是「汽水」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他点了一杯加冰的汽水。

senses.title: Soda compound
senses.definition: a white compound used in cooking, cleaning, and industry
senses.definitionCN: 用于烹饪、清洁和工业的白色化合物
senses.example: Add a spoon of baking soda to the flour.
senses.exampleCN: 往面粉里加一勺小苏打。
senses.why: This is the chemical sense behind the name.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词背后的化学义项。

senses.title: Fizzy drink
senses.definition: a sweet drink made with carbonated water
senses.definitionCN: 用碳酸水制成的甜味饮料
senses.example: He ordered a soda with ice.
senses.exampleCN: 他点了一杯加冰的汽水。
senses.why: Everyday use names a sweet soft drink.
senses.whyCN: 日常用法指甜的软饮料。

senses.title: Carbonated water
senses.definition: water charged with gas and often used in mixed drinks
senses.definitionCN: 充入气体、常用于调配饮料的水
senses.example: She drinks soda water with lemon.
senses.exampleCN: 她喝加柠檬的苏打水。
senses.why: The word also names the plain fizzy water.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也指不加糖的气泡水。

intro.en: Soda came through Italian and medieval Latin from an Arabic word for a salt plant.
intro.cn: soda 经意大利语和中世纪拉丁语来自阿拉伯语中表示盐生植物的词。

items.en: Soda named a salt-rich plant used for cleaning.
items.cn: soda 指一种富含盐分、用于清洁的植物。

items.en: The word named the compound taken from that plant.
items.cn: 这个词指从该植物中取得的化合物。

items.en: English adopted soda for the white alkaline powder.
items.cn: 英语借入 soda，指白色碱性粉末。

items.en: Soda water brought the sense of fizzy water.
items.cn: soda water 带来了气泡水的意思。

items.en: American shops made soda a word for a sweet drink.
items.cn: 美国商店使 soda 成为甜味饮料的叫法。

note.en: Soda is compared with look-alike words and other drinks.
note.cn: 把 soda 与形近词以及其他饮料词作比较。

abstract.en: Ordinary things often hide a chemical story.

sensesIntro.en: Soda is a chemical compound, a sweet fizzy drink, or carbonated water.
sensesIntro.cn: soda 指一种化合物、甜味汽水，或苏打水。

core.en: A salt that ends up in bubbles.

branches.en: White powder helps bread rise.
branches.cn: 白色粉末帮助面包发起。

branches.en: A sweet drink fizzes in the glass.

branches.en: Plain fizzy water is served with lemon.

branches.en: The powder and the drink share one name.

definition_en: the upper layer of earth where plants grow, a country's land, or to make something dirty
core_image: 双手捧起一把松软的深色泥土
scene: 这片土壤适合种蔬菜。This soil is good for vegetables.
sceneCN: 这里 soil 是「土壤」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这片土壤适合种蔬菜。

senses.title: Earth for plants
senses.definition: the upper layer of earth in which plants grow
senses.definitionCN: 植物生长所依赖的地表土层
senses.example: This soil is good for vegetables.
senses.exampleCN: 这片土壤适合种蔬菜。
senses.why: This is the basic agricultural sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的农业义项。

senses.title: Land of a country
senses.definition: the land of a country or region
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区的土地
senses.example: The soldiers fought on foreign soil.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们在异国土地上作战。
senses.why: The word widens from a patch of earth to a nation's ground.
senses.whyCN: 词义从一块土地扩展到一国的土地。

senses.title: Make dirty
senses.definition: to make something dirty
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变脏
senses.example: The muddy boots soiled the carpet.
senses.exampleCN: 泥靴子弄脏了地毯。
senses.why: A separate verb means to stain or dirty.
senses.whyCN: 一个单独的动词表示弄污或弄脏。

intro.en: Soil came from Old French and goes back to Latin solum, meaning ground.
intro.cn: soil 来自古法语，可追溯到拉丁语 solum，意为地面。

items.en: Solum meant ground, floor, or soil.
items.cn: solum 意为地面、地板或土壤。

items.en: Sueil or soil named a piece of ground.
items.cn: sueil 或 soil 指一块土地。

items.en: The word entered English as soil.
items.cn: 这个词以 soil 进入英语。

items.en: It named the earth in which plants grow.

items.en: A related verb came to mean making dirty.
